title: Rehabilitation for Bereaved Families After the Death of a Child: A Retrospective Analysis of 25 Years at Nachsorgeklinik Tannheim
summary:
The death of a child is one of the most devastating experiences a family can face. Parents and siblings often experience long-lasting emotional, physical, and social consequences. Nachsorgeklinik Tannheim is the only specialised rehabilitation centre in Germany offering an inpatient family-oriented rehabilitation programme specifically for bereaved families.

The aim of this study is to evaluate this unique rehabilitation programme using routinely collected clinical data. The study will analyse data from families who participated in the programme between 2001 and 2025. It will examine which families use the programme, their needs and rehabilitation goals, the rehabilitation measures provided, and the documented outcomes at the end of rehabilitation and during routine follow-up.

This is a retrospective observational study. Only existing pseudonymised routine data will be analysed. No participants will be contacted again, and no additional data will be collected. The results are expected to improve the scientific evidence for rehabilitation programmes for bereaved families and support the further development of care.
conditions: Bereaved families (parents and siblings) after the death of a child

interventions.name: Retrospective pseudonymised analysis of routinely collected clinical and rehabilitation data from families who participated in the family-oriented rehabilitation programme for bereaved families at Nachsorgeklinik Tannheim between 2001 and 2025.
